facts.statement: The Company maintains borrowings at a fixed rate and is therefore not exposed to interest rate risk.
facts.quote: The Company has borrowings at a fixed rate therefore not exposed to interest rate risk.

facts.statement: The maximum exposure to credit risk was H 16,507.62 Crores as at 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: The maximum exposure to credit risk was H 16,507.62 Crores and H 16,089.78 Crores, as at 31st March, 2026 and 31st March, 2025 respectively, being the total carrying value of trade receivables, balances with bank, bank deposits,  derivative assets and other financial assets.

facts.statement: Investments in mutual funds amounted to H 6,768.44 Crores as of 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: At 31st March, 2026, the investments in mutual funds amounts to H 6,768.44 Crores (31st March, 2025: H 6,849.31 Crores ).

facts.statement: The value of investments in equity instruments held for long term value accretion was H 75.74 Crores as at 31st March, 2026.
facts.quote: The value of investments in such equity instruments as at 31st March, 2026 is H 75.74 Crores (31st March, 2025: H 54.38 Crores).
